description: Machine-readable governance rules for AI agents using Archon MCP. Use this to pre-validate locally before making MCP calls.
identifierNote: No dashes, spaces, or special characters. PascalCase for entities, camelCase for fields.

manualPathIntermediateStates.description: When using the Pro/Manual path (writing DesignSpec.json directly), you must advance through these intermediate states in order before reaching PLAN_CREATED.
manualPathIntermediateStates.note: These are normally auto-advanced. On the manual path, call archon_workflow_continue for each in sequence. Legacy paths use IR_PARSED and SPEC_CREATED.

proWorkflow.description: The Pro Workflow allows bypassing the UML parser to write DesignSpec.json directly.

governedWorkflow.description: The standard governed workflow using the UML pipeline.

PARSE_ERROR_NO_DOMAINS.message: The parsed UML contains no domains or entities.
PARSE_ERROR_NO_DOMAINS.cause: DSL syntax error causing the parser to skip blocks silently.
PARSE_ERROR_NO_DOMAINS.fix: Ensure you use 'domain Name { entity Name { field: type } }' structure exactly. Check for missing closing braces.

ADDITIONAL_PROPERTIES.cause: Field contains a property not in the Phase 2.6 schema (e.g., isPrimary, isRequired, default).
ADDITIONAL_PROPERTIES.fix: Fields only accept { name, type }. Primary keys are inferred by convention or the 'primary' modifier in DSL.

RESERVED_NAME.cause: Entity name conflicts with a protected system-level identifier.

ILLEGAL_TRANSITION.message: Illegal transition from X to Y
ILLEGAL_TRANSITION.cause: Attempted to skip intermediate workflow states.
ILLEGAL_TRANSITION.fix: See manualPathIntermediateStates for the required sequence.
